docs.text: Working capital loan eligibility criteria: minimum 6 months on platform, minimum avg monthly settlement ₹50000, minimum settlement consistency score 0.7.
Bronze tier working capital loan: minimum avg monthly settlement ₹50000, max loan ₹50000, interest rate 19.5%, tenure 6 months.
Silver tier working capital loan: minimum avg monthly settlement ₹150000, max loan ₹200000, interest rate 17.0%, tenure 9 months.
Gold tier working capital loan: minimum avg monthly settlement ₹300000, max loan ₹500000, interest rate 15.0%, tenure 12 months.
Auto-approve threshold ₹100000. Escalate to relationship manager if requested amount exceeds ₹200000.
Escalation rule: Escalate to human relationship manager if requested loan amount > INR 200,000
Escalation rule: Escalate if settlement_consistency_score < 0.8 regardless of amount
Escalation rule: Escalate if merchant has not accepted a financial product offer twice before (avoid repeat-nudge fatigue)
Escalation rule: Never auto-submit an application without explicit one-tap merchant consent
Shop Protect (fire & theft): eligibility — any merchant with physical storefront, min 3 months on platform. Indicative annual premium ₹2400.
Health Cover for Merchant + Family: eligibility — any merchant, min 1 month on platform. Indicative annual premium ₹6000.
